jobDescription:
MANDATORY ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT

Excellent spoken, written and understanding of English are mandatory for this position.


ONLY APPLY IF YOU ARE CONFIDENT WITH YOUR ENGLISH.


You must be able to speak, understand, read and write English confidently and professionally, as the role involves regular communication with management, colleagues, customers, parents and external organisations.

Please do not apply if you are not confident communicating in English in a professional working environment.


AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead


Job Type: Full-Time
Position: AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead
Industry: Education & Technology
Contract: Temporary/ Contractual


About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, highly motivated and forward-thinking AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead to take ownership of the research, development, implementation and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our organisation.

This is not simply an IT support or ChatGPT-based role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and emerging technology and wants to become deeply involved in helping us build an AI-enabled organisation.

You will work closely with senior management, learn how different areas of the company operate, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, education, administration, marketing, customer experience and overall business performance.


The role combines AI research, development, automation, integration, dashboard creation, data visualisation, experimentation, implementation, training and strategic thinking.


Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

  • Researching new and emerging AI technologies, platforms and models.
  • Identifying opportunities to use AI and automation throughout the organisation.
  • Developing and implementing AI-powered workflows and business processes.
  • Automating repetitive and time-consuming administrative tasks.
  • Integrating AI with existing company software, websites, databases and platforms.
  • Building AI assistants, copilots, agents and agentic workflows.
  • Developing autonomous and semi-autonomous AI processes with appropriate human oversight.
  • Developing API, webhook and third-party software integrations.
  • Exploring Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging AI interoperability standards.
  • Developing internal AI tools, applications and dashboards.
  • Designing and building professional, interactive dashboards for management and different areas of the organisation.
  • Creating real-time and automated dashboards that bring together information from multiple systems and data sources.
  • Developing KPI, student-performance, operational, financial, marketing, CRM, sales and management dashboards.
  • Using AI within dashboards to analyse data, identify trends, highlight risks and opportunities, and generate actionable insights.
  • Developing AI-powered reporting and natural-language analytics, allowing authorised users to ask questions about company data and receive reports, summaries, charts and insights.
  • Exploring AI-assisted software development and coding agents.
  • Developing AI-powered knowledge bases and internal search systems.
  • Implementing RAG, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases and knowledge-management solutions.
  • Exploring AI-powered document processing and information extraction.
  • Developing AI-assisted data analysis, reporting and business intelligence.
  • Exploring predictive analytics and decision-support systems.
  • Supporting AI integration within CRM, customer service, admissions and communication systems.
  • Developing marketing, content and social-media automations.
  • Exploring AI-powered voice, telephone and conversational systems.
  • Exploring AI-generated images, audio, video, avatars and multimedia.
  • Investigating computer-use agents capable of interacting with browsers and software.
  • Exploring multimodal AI capable of understanding text, images, documents, audio and video.
  • Evaluating open-source, cloud-based, local and private AI models.
  • Exploring model customisation, fine-tuning and domain-specific AI where appropriate.
  • Monitoring the accuracy, reliability and performance of AI systems.
  • Developing AI evaluation and quality-assurance processes.
  • Maintaining appropriate human review for important AI-generated outputs.
  • Evaluating AI costs, subscriptions, API usage and return on investment.
  • Supporting AI security, privacy, GDPR, safeguarding and governance requirements.
  • Training staff in the effective and responsible use of AI.
  • Creating internal AI procedures, documentation and best-practice guidelines.
  • Monitoring developments within the global AI industry and recommending technologies the organisation should investigate.
  • Developing and maintaining a longer-term AI Transformation Roadmap for the organisation.

You are not expected to be an expert in every area.

What matters is your ability to learn rapidly, investigate unfamiliar technologies, experiment intelligently and turn promising ideas into practical solutions.


AI in Education

As an education organisation, a major part of our AI strategy will involve exploring how technology can improve teaching and learning.


Projects may include:

  • AI tutoring systems
  • Personalised and adaptive learning
  • Intelligent question generation
  • Assessment creation
  • AI-assisted marking
  • Automated feedback
  • Student performance analysis
  • Student progress and performance dashboards
  • Tutor and classroom performance dashboards
  • Identification of individual learning gaps
  • Personalised revision recommendations
  • Curriculum mapping
  • Tutor and teacher assistants
  • Educational resource development
  • Mathematics and English support
  • Comprehension and vocabulary development
  • Verbal and Non-Verbal Reasoning
  • Creative Writing support
  • Student progress reporting
  • Parent reporting
  • Educational quality assurance

Accuracy and safeguarding are extremely important. AI-generated educational content must therefore be properly tested, reviewed and quality controlled.



We do not want somebody who is dependent upon one particular AI provider.


The successful candidate should be able to compare technologies and select the most appropriate solution for each business requirement.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in somebody who is:

  • Passionate about AI and emerging technology.
  • Extremely curious and willing to learn.
  • Self-motivated.
  • Technically confident.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Highly organised.
  • Analytical.
  • Commercially aware.
  • An excellent problem-solver.
  • Comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Able to research independently.
  • Able to work collaboratively.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of projects.
  • Able to communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Able to turn complex data into clear, useful dashboards and management information.
  • Prepared to challenge inefficient processes.
  • Persistent when solving difficult problems.
  • Focused on practical outcomes rather than technology for technology's sake.
  • Excited by the rapid development of AI.

Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy learning.

AI is developing too quickly for anyone to rely solely on what they already know.

Take Ownership

We are not looking for somebody who simply waits to be given individual tasks.

We want somebody whose approach is:

Explore Identify Research Design Build Test Validate Implement Measure Improve

You should be willing to examine an existing process and ask:

"Is there a better way of doing this, and can AI or automation help us achieve it?"

You will be encouraged to research technologies, propose ideas, build prototypes, test solutions and take successful projects through to implementation.

Full-Time Commitment

This is a full-time role requiring significant commitment and engagement with the organisation during and alongside our normal company operating hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an integral and long-term part of the organisation rather than simply providing occasional AI consultancy.

The successful candidate will be expected to continually learn and develop as AI technology evolves.


Learning & Career Development

This position offers significant scope for professional development.

You will have opportunities to:

  • Research emerging AI technologies.
  • Experiment with new platforms.
  • Develop real-world AI solutions.
  • Build AI agents and automated systems.
  • Design and develop business intelligence and management dashboards.
  • Work directly with senior management.
  • Gain experience across multiple business functions.
  • Develop AI strategies and implementation plans.
  • Lead significant AI projects.
  • Train and support colleagues.
  • Develop specialist technical expertise.
  • Build a substantial portfolio of practical AI implementations.
  • Progress as the organisation's AI capabilities expand.

For the right individual, the position has the potential to develop into a senior role with responsibility for the organisation's wider AI strategy, automation, business intelligence and digital transformation.


What Success Looks Like

Initially, you will learn how our organisation operates and identify opportunities where AI and automation can make an immediate difference.


You will then help develop an AI Transformation Roadmap, covering:

  • Immediate opportunities and quick wins
  • Automation opportunities
  • Medium-term AI projects
  • Strategic AI initiatives
  • Educational AI development
  • System integrations
  • Management dashboards and business intelligence
  • Centralised data and reporting
  • Productivity improvements
  • Cost-saving opportunities
  • New products and services
  • Security and governance
  • Future technology requirements

Projects should be assessed according to:

Business Impact Feasibility Cost Risk Scalability

Ultimately, your work should help us:

Reduce Administration Increase Productivity Improve Quality Personalise Learning Improve Customer Experience Improve Decision-Making Improve Data Visibility Reduce Costs Develop New Capabilities Create New Opportunities


How to Apply

Please submit your CV and covering letter explaining:

  1. Your practical experience with AI and automation.
  2. Which AI platforms, models and technologies you have worked with.
  3. Examples of AI systems, agents, automations or applications you have personally developed.
  4. Your experience with APIs and software integrations.
  5. Your coding/programming experience.
  6. Your experience creating dashboards, business intelligence systems or data visualisations, including the platforms you have used.
  7. An example of a business process you have automated or significantly improved.
  8. Which area of AI currently interests you most and why.
  9. What AI technologies you are currently learning.
  10. Where you believe AI is heading over the next 35 years.
  11. How you believe AI could transform a growing education organisation.
  12. What you would investigate during your first 30 days in this position.
  13. Links to any relevant GitHub repositories, portfolios, dashboards, demonstrations, applications or projects you have developed.

Please also answer the following question:

"If you were given responsibility for transforming our organisation through AI, what are the first three areas you would investigate, and why?"

We are looking for someone who doesn't just want a job in AI. We want someone who wants to continuously learn, build, experiment and ultimately help us create an AI-enabled organisation.

If you are ambitious, technically curious and excited about where Artificial Intelligence is heading, we would love to hear from you.

By month two: every agents tool and connector calls route through a common, monitored MCP layer rather than one-off integrations.

title: FinCrime Compliance - Staff
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Compliance team at EY GDS partners with other EY offices across the globe to provide an array of compliance solutions to our clients. The team works on short to long term engagements to assist in establishing, maintaining, and reviewing the outputs of business functions and compliance programs.

Financial crime risks relating to anti-money laundering (AML), terrorist financing, anti-bribery controls, sanctions compliance and fraud are a high focus for regulated businesses and external scrutiny as regulation and practice continues to evolve. Responsible for developing and overseeing the financial crime and fraud prevention framework, designed to ensure client(s) are compliant, protected from risk and loss from financial crime.

The Opportunity

As a part of our Global Managed Services Delivery team, you will be working with EY offices across the globe to provide an array of compliance solutions to our clients. The team works on short to long term engagements to provide assistance in establishing, maintaining and reviewing the outputs of business functions and compliance programs.

Our Financial Crime Consulting team consists of hundreds of professionals who advise and drive change for the firms banking, capital markets, insurance, and asset management clients in Financial Crime. Our Financial Crime Consulting team specializes in several areas, including:

  • AML transaction monitoring
  • SAR drafting
  • Fraud Investigation
  • Crypto investigation
  • Customer screening
  • Payment screening filtering for Sanctions, PEPs and adverse media
  • KYC Remediation
  • Compliance testing and FATCA
  • Financial crime risk assessment reviews
  • AI Tools Automation

Key Responsibilities

As a Financial Crime Compliance Analyst, you will predominantly support the compliance team in the financial crime space. You will help businesses comply with financial crime regulations and adhere to relevant client(s) policies and procedures related to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing.

  • Multi-tasker, learn on the job and work to meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Devising process documentation and translating complex processes into easy-to-follow instructions
  • Coordinating efforts with internal stakeholders as appropriate
  • Work as a member of a team to ensure operational readiness of applications and processes required to conduct AML program requirements
  • Seek to understand the overall process and objective before beginning to work on a task
  • Escalate issues and problems, articulate clearly to leadership, onshore and client team
  • Demonstrate integrity, respect and be able to work collaboratively with team members
  • Apply AI tools and automation techniques to support financial crime compliance workstreams.

Proficiency in Transaction Monitoring Space

  • Customer transactions: Oversee transactions, including transfers, deposits, and withdrawals, to identify suspicious activity
  • Customer Information Review: Assess historical and current customer data and interactions to detect potential financial crime risks
  • Suspicious Activity Reporting (SARs): Investigate and report suspicious activity, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML) concerns, for assigned business units
  • In-depth understanding of Transaction monitoring and risks in each Segment:
    • Wealth Management Risk: Familiarity with the unique risks associated with wealth management, such as high-net-worth client transactions and complex financial instruments
    • Commercial Banking Transactions: An understanding of the risks inherent in commercial banking transactions, including due diligence requirements for loan transactions, deposits, and trade finance activities
    • Corporate Transaction Monitoring: Knowledge of the process for monitoring corporate client transactions, identifying potential risks in business accounts, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations
    • Correspondent Banking Risk Detection: Familiarity with the risks associated with correspondent banking relationships, including cross-border transactions, and ensuring compliance with international AML standards

Skills and Attributes for Success

  • Time management skills to be able to manage deadlines effectively
  • Exhibit analytical skills and attention to detail while maintaining a holistic view and logical thinking
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve research, analysis, investigation quality and operational efficiency.
  • Proficiency in Generative AI and prompt engineering, with the ability to design effective prompts and leverage AI tools to enhance research, analysis, problem-solving, and operational efficiency.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Bachelors / Master s degree in finance, accounting, economics, law, or a related field
  • 1-3 years of work experience in AML Transaction Monitoring
  • Demonstrated experience in a consulting role or within a large corporate environment, with a strong understanding of global Financial Crime Compliance practices
  • Good understanding of SAR drafting and AML regulatory reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data
  • Good understanding of banking industry, its products, and services
  • Experience analysing financial/bank statements
  • Experience in interpreting policy documents
  • Willingness to work from office; 5 days a week
  • Willingness to work on Indian Holidays as per client requirement
  • Willingness to work in shifts, if required
  • Willingness to travel, within the country and internationally as required

  • Review completed annotations and correct errors where required.

  • Participate in training, calibration sessions and feedback discussions.
  • Escalate unclear or ambiguous cases to the QA/Team Lead.
  • Ensure timely completion of assigned annotation volumes.

  • Good attention to detail and ability to perform repetitive visual tasks accurately.
  • Comfortable working with images and video frames.
  • Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn annotation tools quickly.
  • Good English comprehension.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and annotation guidelines.
  • Good typing and computer navigation skills.
  • Willingness to work on a short-term project for approximately 3.5 months.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience in data annotation / image annotation / video annotation.
  • Experience with tools such as CVAT, Labelbox, Supervisely, Scale AI or similar platforms.
  • Experience with key-point annotation, bounding boxes, polygons or object tracking.
  • Previous experience working on sports/sports-video annotation projects.
  • Knowledge of American Football/NFL will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

  • Consistent with repetitive annotation tasks

What would you do Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. Accentures Trust Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society. You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns. This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accentures well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.

  • Excellent comprehension, communication, and (insert language) skills
  • Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of client policies
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills Preferred Qualifications
  • Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
  • High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported

  • Your primary interaction is within your own team and your direct supervisor
  • In this role you will be given detailed instructions on all tasks
  • The decisions that you make impact your own work and are closely supervised
  • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team with a predetermined, narrow scope of work
  • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts
  • Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels
  • Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and/or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.
  • Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team
  • Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.

  • Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy.

    Qualification Any Graduation

Insurity's Next Interfaces Administrator will be the go-to specialist for our AI-enabled integrations and automations, ensuring critical workflows, agents, and data flows run reliably every day. We're looking for someone with 1 year of experience in a 24x7 high-availability production environment. Job Summary

Were looking for a Social Media Organic Growth Specialist to build and scale our organic brand presence across social media platforms and YouTube. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands social-first storytelling, internet culture, content strategy, and community building.

Beyond creating engaging content, youll be responsible for developing content IPs (recurring formats, series, and shows) that audiences recognize, return to, and share. Youll also leverage your understanding of SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and Online Reputation Management (ORM) to ensure every piece of content strengthens the brands visibility across search engines, AI answer platforms, and online conversations.

Your primary focus will be organic growth driving reach, engagement, brand awareness, and audience loyalty without relying heavily on paid media.

Key Responsibilities

  • Social Media Organic Growth
    • Own the day-to-day management of the brands social media channels, including Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
    • Develop and execute content calendars aligned with business, marketing, and brand objectives.
    • Create, curate, and publish engaging content across formats including posts, carousels, reels, stories, shorts, and videos.
    • Produce content designed to earn organic reach, engagement, and shares rather than simply maintaining a posting schedule.
    • Stay on top of platform trends, memes, creator formats, and algorithm updates, adapting them creatively while maintaining the brand voice.
    • Write compelling, platform-native copy and captions.
    • Build and nurture an active community by responding to comments, messages, and conversations in a timely and authentic manner.
  • YouTube Growth Content IP Development
    • Own and grow the brands YouTube presence across both long-form content and Shorts.
    • Conceptualize, launch, and scale recurring content IPs, series, and shows that build audience loyalty and brand recall.
    • Collaborate with presenters, editors, designers, and production teams to maintain consistency in quality, publishing cadence, and format identity.
    • Optimize titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, and metadata to maximize discoverability and audience retention.
    • Analyze content performance to identify winning formats, double down on successful content, and continuously iterate on underperforming concepts.
  • SEO, AEO Search Visibility
    • Apply SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) best practices across social and video content to improve discoverability on Google Search, YouTube, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search experiences.
    • Optimize metadata, descriptions, keywords, transcripts, and content structure for long-term organic visibility.
    • Collaborate with the SEO and Content teams to align social content with strategic keyword and topic priorities.
  • Online Reputation Management (ORM)
    • Monitor conversations and public sentiment across social platforms, Reddit, Quora, review sites, and community forums.
    • Identify emerging negative narratives or reputation risks and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
    • Ensure organic content consistently reinforces an authentic, trustworthy, and positive brand narrative.
    • Support initiatives that improve brand perception and strengthen online credibility.
  • Organic Growth Strategy Reporting
    • Track and report key organic performance metrics including:
      • Reach
      • Engagement
      • Follower growth
      • Share of Voice
      • Watch time
      • Audience retention
      • YouTube channel performance
    • Run structured content experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and documented learnings.
    • Develop repeatable playbooks around high-performing formats and growth strategies.
    • Collaborate closely with Design, Content, Marketing, and Product teams to align organic initiatives with larger campaigns and launches.
    • Support product launches, campaigns, and announcements through strategic organic amplification.

Key Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience managing brand or creator social media accounts with demonstrated success in driving organic growth.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and their algorithms, particularly Instagram and YouTube.
  • Working knowledge of SEO , Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) , and YouTube search optimization.
  • Understanding of Online Reputation Management (ORM) principles and how organic content influences brand perception.
  • Experience building or contributing to recurring content formats, creator series, or branded content IPs is highly preferred.
  • Excellent copywriting skills with a strong understanding of platform-specific tone and voice.
  • Strong awareness of internet culture, trends, and emerging content formats.
  • Experience using social media analytics tools such as Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI-powered content and research tools.
  • Experience with social media management platforms like Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Prior experience working in a startup or high-growth environment is preferred.

What Were Looking For

  • A creative thinker with a strong understanding of internet culture and digital storytelling.
  • Someone who thinks beyond individual posts and builds scalable content systems and recurring formats.
  • A highly proactive individual with strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and project management abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Curious, analytical, and excited to experiment with new ideas to drive organic growth.

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

Responsibilities

  • Own LinkedIn outbound by running targeted, personalised outreach to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior stakeholder buyers.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline by researching and engaging in-ICP accounts and booking qualified meetings for the UK Account Executive team.
  • Partner closely with UK Account Executives on account strategy, messaging and seamless meeting handover to ensure no opportunities are lost.
  • Conduct first-touch qualification using MEDDPICC principles to identify genuine customer challenges before handing meetings to the Account Executive team.
  • Achieve activity and outcome targets through consistent daily outreach, strong connection and reply rates, and qualified meeting bookings.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in HubSpot and manage outbound sequences using tools such as HeyReach, Smartlead and Clay/Apollo.
  • Continuously test and optimise outbound messaging and sequences to improve reply rates and conversion performance.

Requirements

  • Industry experience would be a great advantage, with a background in staff augmentation / tech talent as a service, and an understanding of the model, the buyer and the objections.
  • Alternatively, strong experience in tech recruitment and staffing outbound or SDR, with the ability to open a retained, long-term relationship rather than a one-off placement.
  • Alternatively, B2B SaaS or technology SDR/BDR experience selling to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.
  • Comfortable prospecting into CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An excellent written communicator in English, with a natural, human outbound style, not "spray and pray".
  • Highly organised and able to manage high volume without dropping quality.
  • Familiar with MEDDPICC qualification principles.
  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission and a clear path to promotions.
  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

We are seeking a Senior Systems Analyst, Planning to own how planning data moves across e.l.f. s landscape. e.l.f. is modernizing its planning through a new integrated planning platform built on Lyric, which replaces SAP IBP and extends across the e.l.f., Rhode, and Naturium brands. Responsibilities



  • Own the planning data pipeline end to end: understand the demand and supply planning processes, and translate them into how data needs to behave across Lyric, Snowflake, and SAP S/4.

  • Partner with the vendor team that builds and supports the Lyric data model and integration, owning the outcome that planning data moves correctly across platforms.

  • Understand how the SAP side of planning works well enough to know what SAP expects to receive and what it produces back, and to confirm forecasts and allocations land correctly (planned independent requirements for MRP, order allocation, and the master data behind them). You do not need to be deeply fluent in SAP planning configuration.

  • Support the multi-brand rollout across e.l.f., Rhode, and Naturium as the platform scales.

Good to have



  • Experience with cloud data and integration tooling in our stack and exposure to the beauty or broader consumer goods industry is a plus.
